title: test(dogfood): pin that an uninstalled package's commit is refused through its own revert / rollback path
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 已落地工作欠的后续（test-only pin），PR #29090 合约复审记录 ③ 点名的 should-fix；落点具名，行为已发布。
业务理由: #29090 的 changeset 对外写明「已卸载包的提交，经它自己的路径回滚/回退也答 404」，但这一句现在只是读代码得出的，没有测试钉住；以后有人改 `uninstallPackage` 或回退门的判断顺序，这句发布出去的话可能悄悄变成假的。
动手的读者: domain:server 席，`packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-commit-revert-path-package.dogfood.test.ts` 加一例。
查重: `uninstalled package commit revert` 21 命中（含已关）；最近邻 #28987（本缺陷的卡，已由 #29090 关闭），没有这条 pin 的卡。

Follow-up of: #28987 (landing PR #29090; the landing record there names this card)

## What is missing
The dogfood file pins every scenario of the #29090 narrowing except one: a package that was installed and then uninstalled. Its commits stay in the trail (`GET /:id/commits` still serves them), and `POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert` and `POST /packages/:id/rollback` now answer `404 Package 'ID' not found` for it. The changeset declares this in its third FROM → TO pair. The dogfood "unknown package" case uses an id that was never installed, so it does not cover this.

## Acceptance
- One case on the dogfood file: install a package, make a commit, uninstall it, then revert and roll back through its own path. Both answer 404 and write nothing; `GET /:id/commits` still lists the commit.
- Test only; no source change. If the case reds on main, stop: that is a defect in a landed narrowing. Report it with the reading instead of fixing it here.
